Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage large-scale public engagement programs, and translate complex information into clear, actionable communication. hero.intro: I am an International Relations graduate specializing in International Political Economy, with hands-on experience across Indonesia's trade and financial regulatory institutions: Ministry of Trade, Bank Indonesia, and OJK. During my internships, I produced analytical reports on regional inflation for multi-government policy coordination meetings, processed 50+ consumer dispute cases with a 9.0/10 performance evaluation and facilitated financial literacy programs for 300+ participants. I am currently seeking opportunities in government & institutional affairs or trade policy roles within multinational organizations where I can apply my understanding of economic policy and stakeholder engagement.

statement: At Bank Indonesia I wrote regional inflation reports. At OJK I reviewed consumer complaints. On irfolks I write about economics and geopolitics in my own time.

experience.summary: Reviewed and processed more than 50 consumer dispute cases in the IASC portal. Internship evaluation: 9.0/10 (Very Good), assessed by OJK East Java.

Wrote at least five analytical reports on regional inflation and food security, used as input at TPID coordination meetings. Coordinated the publication of more than ten institutional programs with local governments, universities and community organizations, and handled documentation for stakeholder events. Delivered public education sessions on QRIS and digital financial literacy for 300+ participants.

Wrote more than 100 research-based, SEO-optimized articles on MSME digitalization. Adapted technical business topics for non-technical small-business owners, and worked with the marketing team on brand messaging.
